overall_safety_summary: One or more predefined rules were triggered.

hazards.description: A detected bottle is positioned near the visible image boundary.
hazards.explanation: The bottle may be close to the counter edge and could fall, spill or break.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: A fallen bottle or spilled liquid may create an obstruction or slipping hazard.
hazards.recommended_action: Place the bottle in a stable area away from the counter edge.

hazards.description: A detected bowl is positioned near the visible image boundary.
hazards.explanation: The bowl may be close to the edge of the work surface and could be knocked over.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Spilled food or a fallen bowl may create clutter, slipping risk or a need for sudden movement.
hazards.recommended_action: Move the bowl toward the centre of the working surface.

hazards.description: A person is very close to a detected oven.
hazards.explanation: Close interaction with an oven may create a burn risk if the appliance or nearby cookware is hot.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Reduced heat sensitivity, balance or reaction speed may increase burn risk.
hazards.recommended_action: Maintain a stable posture and use appropriate protection when interacting with the oven.

hazards.description: A detected bottle is positioned close to an oven or toaster.
hazards.explanation: A bottle placed near a hot appliance may become hot, melt, leak or contain a flammable cooking liquid.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: A heated or leaking bottle may be harder to handle quickly and may increase burn, fire or slipping risk.
hazards.recommended_action: Move the bottle away from hot appliances and place it on a cool, stable surface.

hazards.rule_name: Cup or bowl close to oven
hazards.description: A detected cup or bowl is positioned very close to an oven.
hazards.explanation: The container may hold hot contents, become heated or be knocked over while the oven is being used.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Reduced grip strength or reaction speed may increase the likelihood and severity of a hot spill.
hazards.recommended_action: Place cups and bowls on a stable surface away from the oven opening and hot cookware.

uncertainties: The baseline is limited to predefined rules and YOLO detections.
It cannot reason about hazards outside its fixed rule set.
